name: legitimate-e-invoice
description: False-positive resistance: a supplier invoice delivered in a national e-invoicing format, as an XML file with a PDF copy beside it. Structured invoices travel as .xml by law in several countries, so the file type is the most ordinary attachment such a supplier sends, and the word 'invoice' is always next to it. Reading .xml as a web page paired that with the invoice wording into a critical malware-pretext finding.

email.subject: Invoice 118/2026 - electronic invoice and PDF copy
email.bodyText:
Dear Sam,

please find attached invoice 118/2026 for the September shipment of packaging materials. The XML file is the electronic invoice as lodged with the tax exchange system; the PDF is a readable copy of the same document for your records.

Payment terms are unchanged: 60 days end of month, to the account printed on the invoice.

Kind regards,
Giulia Marchetti
Accounts, Northwind Forniture S.r.l.
